US-EN-50043253.title: Trouble brewing for the Patriots? Barnwell on five important Week 3 losses and their aftermath
US-EN-50043253.description: The Pats got blown out. The Seahawks lost to a QB2. The Panthers couldn't overcome injuries. The Chargers and Texans fell to 0-3. What now for five of last season's playoff teams?

US-EN-50043815.title: 3.6% lost win probability, 2,870 days and 3.19 seconds: Our 'Next Ben Stats' from Week 3
US-EN-50043815.description: Coaching decisions costing the Texans? Milestones for a Commanders LB and Raiders-Saints TEs? And more.

US-EN-50051321.title: Sources: Giants pass rusher Burns believed to have torn ACL
US-EN-50051321.description: New York Giants standout pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have sustained a torn ACL during Sunday's 12-7 win over the Tennessee Titans, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

US-EN-50050195.title: Payton: Broncos can't keep relying on comebacks
US-EN-50050195.description: In their latest wild ending, the Broncos rebounded from a first-half shutout to score a 30-26 victory over the Rams.

US-EN-50051498.title: Commanders LB Chenal to have season-ending neck surgery, sources confirm
US-EN-50051498.description: Commanders linebacker Leo Chenal, who was carted off the field during the team's win over the Seahawks on Sunday, will undergo season-ending neck surgery, sources confirmed to NFL Network.

US-EN-50049529.title: Saints confused after again ending up on losing end of fumble ruling
US-EN-50049529.description: The Saints walked away from Sunday's home loss to the Raiders just as confused about the application of the quarterback fumble rules as they were in Week 1.

US-EN-50049488.title: Ravens win in wild finish after Cowboys' kick paves way to Loop walk-off FG
US-EN-50049488.description: Lamar Jackson, Tyler Loop and the Ravens delivered one of the most remarkable last-second victories in recent NFL history Sunday, thanks to a late fourth-quarter decision made by the Cowboys.

US-EN-50047972.title: Bucs QB Mayfield has dislocated thumb, will undergo MRI
US-EN-50047972.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated right thumb in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, coach Todd Bowles said.

US-EN-50051074.title: Sources: Commanders set for Ekeler reunion, will add veteran to RB room
US-EN-50051074.description: The Commanders are expected to sign free agent running back Austin Ekeler to their 53-man roster, pending a physical, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

US-EN-50046851.title: Injured Jefferson exits Vikings' victory, was 'close' to returning
US-EN-50046851.description: Vikings star receiver Justin Jefferson was ruled out of Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after a first-quarter injury to his left ankle.

US-EN-50046373.title: 😈 Ravens poke fun after win in Rio, topping trolls
US-EN-50046373.description: The Washington Commanders followed up their upset victory over the Seattle Seahawks with a petty post.

US-EN-50043408.title: Big wins for the Broncos, Ravens, Jags and Steelers? Our reporters make sense of Week 3
US-EN-50043408.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 3.

US-EN-50043224.title: Let's overreact to NFL Week 3: Brock Purdy is the MVP front-runner?
US-EN-50043224.description: Is Brock Purdy the MVP frontrunner? Are the Steelers going to have another winning season? We're judging Week 3 overreactions.

US-EN-50051416.title: 'This one hurts': How are Cowboys reacting to third straight 1-2 start?
US-EN-50051416.description: Dallas finished 7-9-1 in 2025 and 7-10 in 2024 after winning one of its first three games. Will 2026 be any different?

US-EN-50042344.title: DeVonta Smith is Eagles' undisputed No. 1 WR. He was shaped by perseverance
US-EN-50042344.description: The Eagles' go-to guy in key moments has always seen himself as WR1 -- now everyone else is just catching up.

US-EN-50044351.title: Where has Bears TE Colston Loveland been this season?
US-EN-50044351.description: The tight end has one catch and faces a tough Eagles defense on MNF. With no Caleb Williams, can he get going?

US-EN-50049468.title: Patrick Mahomes perfect on play-action passes in win vs. Dolphins: 'It's opening up a lot'
US-EN-50049468.description: Mahomes completed all 14 of his play-action attempts for 201 yards, including a touchdown, according to ESPN Research.

US-EN-50048227.title: Joe Burrow, Bengals can't 'close it out' against Steelers
US-EN-50048227.description: Special teams gaffes and a Burrow fumble late in the fourth sealed Cincinnati's outcome.

US-EN-50049013.title: Cardinals rookie Jeremiyah Love earns bigger role in offense
US-EN-50049013.description: The running back out of Notre Dame rushed 21 times for 90 yards and caught five passes, including a TD.

US-EN-FFSundayHighLows-50044626.title: Week 3 winners and losers: Gibbs, Smith-Njigba stay hot; St. Brown, Taylor go quiet
US-EN-FFSundayHighLows-50044626.description: Jahmyr Gibbs and Jaxon Smith-Njigba came up big in Week 3, while Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jonathan Taylor had very quiet days.

US-EN-40699880.title: Fantasy football buzz: Top scorers through Sunday Night Football
US-EN-40699880.description: A closer look at the leading fantasy scorers of the day, from Jahmyr Gibbs and Jaxon Smith-Njigba to Geno Smith and Garrett Wilson.

US-EN-49745176.title: NFL playoff picture: Updated projections, chances to make the postseason
US-EN-49745176.description: We're looking ahead to how the 14-team playoff picture could line up -- and who will win divisions -- en route to the Super Bowl.

US-EN-49794361.title: Projecting the 2027 NFL draft order: Which teams could have an early pick?
US-EN-49794361.description: ESPN's Football Power Index projects the 2027 NFL draft order for Round 1, complete with each team's chances to pick in the top five, in the top 10 and at No. 1.

US-EN-50046652.title: 'Bhayshul touchdown is cool': Trevor Lawrence's 1-yard line kneel hurt fantasy managers more than the actual game
US-EN-50046652.description: The quarterback laughed off his clock-killing blunder, acknowledging the obvious fantasy implications after he knelt instead of running into the end zone.

US-EN-49466506.title: NFL betting buzz: 8.5 the magic number for underdogs
US-EN-49466506.description: The four straight-up wins by underdogs of eight points or greater are the most through three weeks of an NFL season since 1978.

US-EN-49881131.description: Will Colin Simmons be the runaway top edge for 2027? How early could Jadan Baugh get picked in April? Here's NFL draft spin off Week 4 of the CFB season.
